notes: RBox revision on in_genus (functionality): a species can belong to more than one genus at the same time (functionality is removed). Instances are two little-known carnivorans (the fossa, genus Cryptoprocta, against Eupleres; the olinguito, genus Bassaricyon, against Nasua), asked as 'Is it consistent with this fact that ...?'. The cross-lingual queries ask the first instance and keep the genus names in Latin. Unrelated near: whether one animal can have two different biological mothers, the same property (functionality) of a relation the genus rank cannot reach (a leak turns no into yes); unrelated far asks a different property of an unrelated relation. hops counts the prompt facts as one bridge. Propositional negation is worded 'Is it true that ... not ...?'. Paired with the contraction and the expansion of the same property. Known weakness: the near question has more than one fair answer (gestational surrogate, egg donor).

The fossa belongs to the genus Cryptopro.why: True: the fossa, Cryptoprocta ferox, is the only living species of its genus. The sentence form is rare; the binomial is the usual way the fact is written.
